why: Measured, not judged: the voice encoder that does the cloning scores take 1 against itself at 1.00, take 2 at 0.846, and the take-2 clone he rejected at 0.817 — his ear and the number agree. Denoising cost identity (0.987) so it was dropped.
construction: Chatterbox conditions on the reference's first 6-10 seconds, so the 10-second window scoring highest against his real voice opens the file; the rest is the next-highest utterances, for the speaker embedding.
